question: Does agreement of fixed W16/core Ridge mean-return forecasts for observed-transition horizons H4/H8/H24 select a subset with different H8 directional accuracy?
interpretation: Exploratory historical benchmark. Agreement is a correlated filter on examples, not independent confirmation or a trading signal.

source_and_scope.source: Audited MT5 demo EURUSD H1 export, using only the pre-test prefix already used in v3.
source_and_scope.source_prefix_end: 2026-07-03T15:00:00Z bar-open; no test rows after the development cutoff are accessed.
source_and_scope.claim_scope: Not an untouched confirmation period; no profitability or significance claim.

saved_prediction_availability.inner_predictions_scope: inner-validation rows only; may be used descriptively, not as outer validation.
saved_prediction_availability.reason_new_fit_needed: The previous v3 inner selector abstained in every fold/track, so no selected outer model predictions exist.

estimand.observed_transition_return: r_j=log(C[i+j]/C[i+j-1]) over adjacent observed rows, including time-gap crossings; no calendar-time division.
estimand.target: y_mean(H)=mean(r_1,...,r_H) for H in {4,8,24}; direction is sign of this per-observed-transition mean.
estimand.anchor: H8 target and H8 forecast define the directional outcome/prediction for every filter comparison.
estimand.zero_rule: Exact zero forecast is abstention. Exact zero realized H8 target is counted separately and excluded from binary accuracy.

fixed_model.input_features: W16 feature matrix columns whose fixed v3 schema groups are own_ohlc_log_ratios, same_bar_cross_ratios, observed_transition_gap (the core mask).
fixed_model.model: Ridge(alpha=1, fit_intercept=True, solver=cholesky), separate mean-only model per H and outer fold.
fixed_model.fit_plan: 4 outer folds x H=4,8,24; no hyperparameter search or inner refits.
fixed_model.scaling: StandardScaler independently on X and that H target using training origins only; inverse-transform predictions to raw log-return units.
fixed_model.device: CPU; one BLAS thread; maximum process CPU budget 900 seconds.
fixed_model.deterministic: No random seed; deterministic Ridge fit.

cohort_and_boundaries.common_origin_definition: Use the existing v3 common-origin rows (origin_row >= 96 and origin_row + 24 < 10621), and require all H4/H8/H24 target/prediction records at each validation origin.
cohort_and_boundaries.train_purge: For every H model, use the same outer-fold training origins from the v3 split membership: H24 target endpoint strictly before fold start.
cohort_and_boundaries.validation: Use the same v3 outer validation origins for all three horizons; decision timestamp in [fold_start, fold_end), with H24 target endpoint strictly before fold end.
cohort_and_boundaries.gap_policy: Keep observed rows across all gaps; no interpolation, history reset, or gap-based origin exclusion.
cohort_and_boundaries.future_metadata: Elapsed duration and target gap-crossing flags are retained only for retrospective description, never as model inputs or eligibility filters.

filters_and_metrics.joint_eligible_origins: All outer validation origins with H4/H8/H24 forecasts and H8 actual target available under the same H24-purged cohort.
filters_and_metrics.H8_only: Reference prediction is sign(H8 forecast); report all-origin performance and coverage.
filters_and_metrics.agreement_H4_H8: Accept iff H4 and H8 forecasts are both nonzero and have the same sign.
filters_and_metrics.agreement_H8_H24: Accept iff H8 and H24 forecasts are both nonzero and have the same sign.
filters_and_metrics.unanimous_H4_H8_H24: Accept iff all three forecasts are nonzero and have the same sign.
filters_and_metrics.two_of_three: Not used; with three nonzero forecasts a majority is automatic and is not the same as an abstention-aware agreement filter.
filters_and_metrics.prediction_semantics: On accepted origins, directional prediction remains sign(H8 forecast). The filter only selects origins; it does not alter H8 predictions.
filters_and_metrics.per_fold_and_overall: Report common origins; accepted/rejected counts and coverage; H8 buy/sell counts; H8 hit on accepted, rejected, and all active forecasts; actual-zero counts separately; H8 forecast-zero abstentions; balanced accuracy when both realized H8 sign classes are present; per-filter train-majority and always-up baseline on accepted origins.
filters_and_metrics.majority_baseline: Per fold, sign of the majority among nonzero training H8 labels; ties produce zero/abstain. Score on each accepted subset with realized-zero outcomes excluded.
filters_and_metrics.always_up_baseline: Predict positive direction on each accepted subset; realized-zero outcomes excluded.
filters_and_metrics.descriptive_audits: Report UTC weekday coverage and H8 target paths crossing a non-one-hour transition for accepted and rejected origins. These are post-hoc descriptive labels only.
filters_and_metrics.no_inference: No IID confidence intervals or significance tests; horizons and neighboring origins have overlapping outcomes.
filters_and_metrics.no_strategy_claim: No trading returns, transaction costs, profitability, or live signal claims.

outputs: saved outer predictions with forecast/origin/target timestamps and actual H8 target kept separate from forecasts
per-fold and pooled descriptive metrics with accepted/rejected cohorts and baselines
fit index, train-only scaler parameters and Ridge coefficients
1-2 real illustrative timestamp rows selected from the saved outer predictions
run metadata with exact fit count, CPU time, source prefix hash and protocol hash
stop_conditions: Stop without fit if source prefix/schema/split hashes or exact origin membership do not match the referenced v3 artifacts.
Stop if any H4/H8/H24 prediction is missing for a common validation origin or if any endpoint violates the H24 purge.
Do not read or score any source rows after the pre-test development prefix.
Do not launch more than 12 fits or any further tuning after this report.
